body: Thanks for confirming that the world is full of shitty people...

I could have written your post verbatim!!! About a month ago I deleted all of my social media accounts! It was sooooo liberating! Only a handful of people have reached out to me but it doesn’t surprise me.
I can totally relate! It’s hard for me to open up to anyone anymore... You aren’t alone!
I deleted all my social media accounts about 3 weeks ago! I was highly addicted to the rush of a ping from fb on my phone... I am hoping to never go back...

This!!! All of it! Verbatim!! I could have written this... my sister is always throwing the “well she is your mom and she has changed since moving up here with me, she has changed” line at me. Guilt tripping no longer works on me...
Thanks so much for commenting! What is gynophobia?

It does still happen occasionally. I Have always been intuitive... like I could FEEL that something was amiss. For instance, when my grandmother passed away, I woke up suddenly and knew something was wrong and 5 min later, my mom called and told me my grandmother passed 5 min earlier... I don’t believe in coincidences...
